text: Python is a high-level programming language used for web development, automation, data science, and artificial intelligence.
C++ is a general-purpose programming language commonly used for competitive programming, system software, and performance-critical applications.
JavaScript is a programming language widely used for building interactive web applications and server-side applications with Node.js.
FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building fast and scalable APIs.
Node.js is a JavaScript runtime used to build scalable backend services and APIs.
Express.js is a lightweight Node.js framework commonly used for creating REST APIs and backend applications.
React is a JavaScript library used to build reusable and interactive user interfaces.
Next.js is a React framework that provides features such as server-side rendering, routing, and full-stack application development.
Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework used to rapidly build custom user interfaces.
MongoDB is a NoSQL document database that stores data in flexible JSON-like documents.
PostgreSQL is a powerful open-source relational database known for reliability, SQL support, and advanced querying capabilities.
Redis is an in-memory data store commonly used for caching, session management, queues, and rate limiting.
Docker is a containerization platform that allows applications and their dependencies to run consistently across environments.
Git is a distributed version control system used to track source code changes and collaborate with other developers.
GitHub Actions is a CI/CD platform that can automate testing, building, and deployment workflows.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines information retrieval with language models to generate answers grounded in external knowledge.
Embeddings represent text as numerical vectors so that semantically similar pieces of information can be compared.
Reranking improves retrieval quality by taking an initial set of retrieved documents and scoring them again using a more precise model.
Machine learning allows systems to learn patterns from data and use those patterns to make predictions or decisions.
Qdrant is a vector database designed for storing embeddings and performing similarity search with metadata filtering.
